verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a public REST API for reading and changing account configuration: adding users, setting up response workflows, checking who is on call, and creating incidents. It also offers an Events API v2 with acknowledge and resolve follow-ups, header-based API versioning, a published OpenAPI schema repository, and an interactive try-it API reference. A community integrator confirms real use of the Events API but reports confusion over v1/v2 key compatibility. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of REST API coverage and reliability, and clearer key/version handling for Events API integrators.
